newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso closes strong on inflows.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso closes strong on inflows.

text.p: * Peso average at 26.332 from 26.343 to the dollar
The Philippine peso reversed its early weakness to settle at 26.331 on Tuesday from the previous close of 26.335 as heavy foreign investments came in, traders said.
The peso fell to a day-low of 26.337 in the first hour of trading after the Central Bank withdrew its term reverse repos from the market with maturities of one to three months.
Strong inflows for portfolio and direct equity investments helped the peso to recover to reach a day-high of 26.327 pesos in later trades, dealers said.
The Central Bank capped the peso's strength by buying $37 million to $59 million at the rates of 26.329 to 26.334 pesos, dealers said.
Market volume swelled to $293.8 million from $141.3 million.
The peso could be stronger on Wednesday but it would be limited at 26.32, one dealer said.
